title: Monotonicity in a Hill spectral band
statement: For real smooth periodic \(u\), prove \(d_{\lambda}(\lambda)\ne0\) on \(\{|d|<1\}\), where \(d=\frac12\operatorname{tr}M\).
status: As of 9 November 2026: A classical affirmative result; the seminar requested a proof. Closed-gap endpoints are excluded from the derivative assertion.

title: Supplementary data for the periodic inverse spectral problem
statement: For real periodic \(u\), determine what data in addition to the Hill discriminant reconstruct \(u\), with basepoint fixed.
status: As of 9 November 2026: Affirmatively solved in particular by band edges plus a sheet-labelled Dirichlet divisor in the finite-gap class; the cited verification here is limited to that match.

title: Approximation by finite-gap periodic potentials
statement: Is the set of real periodic finite-gap Hill potentials dense among real periodic potentials? The precise modern version uses the \(H^m\) norm for each \(m\ge0\).
status: As of 9 November 2026: Yes; finite-gap potentials are dense in every \(H^m\), \(m\ge0\). The original notebook omitted the topology.

title: Recursive construction of KdV Lax operators
statement: Given \(L=-D^2+u\), construct a normalized odd-order \(A_n\) for which \([A_n,L]\) is multiplication, and relate the resulting hierarchy to conserved-density recursions.
status: As of 9 November 2026: The formal hierarchy and its dressing construction are established. The seminar's additional question about unspecified other equations is not a universal classification problem.

title: Soliton collision phase shifts
statement: For a real pure KdV two-soliton solution with distinct positive wave parameters and fixed scattering data, compute the outgoing minus incoming intercept of each soliton center.
status: As of 9 November 2026: The logarithmic pairwise shifts are established; the source itself calls the scattering answer standard.
